assumptions: Revenue growth per year: 8% or more is strong, below 0% is a concern
Gross margin change over the period: up 1 point or more is strong, down 3 points or more is a concern
Operating margin: 15% or more is strong, below 0% is a concern
Net margin: 10% or more is strong, below 0% is a concern
Free cash flow margin: 10% or more is strong, below 0% is a concern
Return on equity: 15% or more is strong, below 5% is a concern
Debt to equity: 1.0 or lower is strong, above 2.0 is a concern
Interest coverage (operating profit / interest): 6x or more is strong, below 2x is a concern
Current ratio: 1.5 or more is strong, below 1.0 is a concern
P/E: 20 or lower is strong, above 40 is a concern (negative earnings are flagged)
Price to sales: 3 or lower is strong, above 10 is a concern
EV/EBITDA: 12 or lower is strong, above 25 is a concern
PEG ratio: 1.5 or lower is strong, above 3 is a concern
Price to free cash flow: 20 or lower is strong, above 50 is a concern
Share count growth per year: under 0.5% is strong, above 4% is a concern (dilution)
Stock-based pay as a share of revenue: under 3% is strong, above 10% is a concern
Operating cash flow / net income: 1.0 or more is strong, below 0.5 is a concern
Insider sales per purchase in recent filings: 2 or fewer is strong, more than 10 is a concern
Beta (swings vs the market): 1.0 or lower is strong, above 1.8 is a concern
Average daily dollar volume: $5M or more is strong, below $500K is a concern (hard to trade)
Short interest as share of float: under 5% is strong, above 15% is a concern
Institutional ownership: 40% or more is strong, below 10% is a concern
Price vs 200-day average: at or above is strong, more than 15% below is a concern
